create_tt_embedding_bag: create a TTEmbeddingBag with specified num_embeddings, embedding_dim, and tt_ranks for tensor train embeddings
create_table_batched_tt_embedding_bag: create a TableBatchedTTEmbeddingBag with multiple tables sharing the same num_embeddings and embedding_dim
run_tt_embedding_lookup: run a forward pass on TTEmbeddingBag with indices and offsets tensors to get embedding sums
compute_suggested_tt_shapes: compute suggested tensor train shapes for a given dimension using the suggested_tt_shapes function
convert_tt_cores_to_full_matrix: convert tensor train cores to a full dense matrix using the tt_matrix_to_full function
